root_causes: Inefficient high-level planning: the planner issued repeated generic Rearrange[toy_pineapple_1, on, chair_32] and Rearrange[stuffed_toy_0, on, chair_32] commands even after one object was already correctly placed, causing redundant behavior and low rewards.
Poor wait/action coordination: Agent 0 spent many steps executing Wait[None] while holding the stuffed toy, instead of placing it or clearing its grasp once its contribution was complete.

Overuse of identical rearrange goals for the same object and target (toy_pineapple_1 onto chair_32) led to unnecessary motion and prolonged task completion after success was already practically achieved.

Insufficient termination condition at the control level: the system continued acting (and even giving 'Wait is still in progress' feedback) after both task propositions were satisfied, driving extra negative reward.
improvement_suggestions: Introduce post-condition checks that suppress new Rearrange commands once an object is already on the desired receptacle, especially when the task proposition for that object is satisfied.

Add a coordination rule to avoid holding objects unnecessarily: once an agent’s object is placed and its subgoal is complete, it should drop or place the object and transition to an idle or assistive state instead of Wait[None] while holding it.
Refine the task-completion / termination logic so that the episode ends promptly when all propositions are satisfied, preventing additional low-value steps with negative reward.

In the high-level planner, diversify target assignments (e.g., one object per target chair as specified) and stop issuing duplicate Rearrange for the same object-target pair unless a failure or displacement is detected.
Penalize or detect repeated no-op waits combined with stable world state, and encourage the planner to issue either a finalizing action or a terminate signal instead.
overall_assessment: The task was ultimately completed successfully, but the trajectory was inefficient, with redundant rearrange commands and unnecessary waiting after success conditions were effectively met. Execution quality is acceptable but could be significantly improved with better post-condition checks and termination logic.
task_instruction: Move the stuffed toy and toy pineapple from the dining room to the living room. Place them on a chair.
